title: Nice down blanket, but not that fluffy!
text:
Nice down blanket, but not that fluffy!. The Dreamhood down comforter came packaged nice. It was in a bag that had the air sucked out of it to make it flat for shipping, and storing.
Once it was opened it does get bigger when you shake it out, but not as fluffy as my other Down does I have. Actually this didn’t come close!

I live in the mountains in ca. where it does get chilly at night.
I was laying down with this blanket on the couch, and it did get warm, and cozy.
The blanket is made well, and the stitching is good, with out loose thread .

In one of my guestrooms is a day bed with a pull out underneath, this will be going in there.
